risk_note: RV2 (funds, read only). adminGetFundLedger is implemented (BR-FUND-20, BR-WDR-18, D10-589). Computed when read from all the entries posted so far, with no accounting-day cut, unlike the asset snapshot: the receivable per platform and in total (an over-collected net stays negative), the negative balances and how many accounts hold them. One repeatable-read transaction so the cards agree. W, P and the water level come from payout through a port handed in by app.module: the W < 1.5 P judgement sits in payout's domain beside the staleness limit, compared as integers (W × 10 < P × 15). No reading, or a stale one, gives water_level null, never a default. entered_by shows the id and name only when it is an admin of this app, null otherwise (D10-592 ③). No write, no audit record, no migration. Not in this task: the alert (B2-09j), the console cards (F1-08gb). Rebased onto B2-09i: both add to payout's application/watermark.ts, both kept; route-schemas.gen.ts regenerated.

The first author hit its usage limit after writing every file and left no output JSON; the red run and these reviews are what checked its work.
